decision_source: explicit project-owner direction in the controlled project session
scope_basis: The workload uses platform-supplied temporary AWS role credentials and stores no application secret.
The workload has no authenticated production integration or real-data source.
The workload accepts synthetic data only and has no collection or cryptographic execution authority.
Creating a managed secret solely for evidence would add cost, permissions, network resources and teardown risk without mitigating a present secret-handling risk.
reactivation_triggers: Any password, token, private key, client secret or credential is introduced.
An authenticated collector, production data source, database or third-party API is introduced.
Real data is enabled or the environment changes from synthetic-staging.
Collection, migration or cryptographic execution authority is proposed.
limitations: This disposition applies only to the current secretless synthetic-staging scope.
It does not demonstrate secret retrieval, rotation, revocation or audit controls.
It does not authorise real data, production integration or cryptographic lifecycle operations.
A real-data pilot still requires a separate external accountable G3 decision.
